entities.summary: Madisonville is a town in St. Tammany Parish in the U.S. state of Louisiana. The population was 748 at the 2010 U.S. census, and 850 at the 2020 U.S. census. It is part of the New Orleans–Metairie–Kenner metropolitan statistical area. The ZIP code is 70447. Madisonville is a human settlement in North America, established around 1800. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
